verdict.rationale: The Wyoming Secretary of State is a government business-filing service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no MCP server, and probes found no llms.txt, no OpenAPI spec and no documented public API. Keyless reachability of the WyoBiz web portal is not an MCP integration and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
